placements.title: Price changes land at the hour buyers can still act on them
placements.frame: When a price changes, does the buyer still have stock to buy and a visible price before the purchase choice, and whose sell-through or predictability is the timing serving?
placements.why: No existing narrative leaves were supplied, so nothing exact, inspired, or close can be reused. MarkdownTimingVisibility holds both statements as one timing decision: the half-price markdown moves to two in the afternoon so buyers can still find day-old loaves, and the shelf card changes at the same hour so the price is known before the till. The theme is a subject future envelopes about price timing and buyer visibility are likely to keep feeding, not a single event, so it passes the grain test.
